render_mesh_with_opendr: create an OpendrRenderer instance and call render with verts, faces, and a background image to produce a rendered mesh image
render_mesh_with_camera: call OpendrRenderer with verts, faces, and a custom camera vector to render a 3D mesh with specified focal length and center
render_model_with_background: call render_model with verts, faces, width, height, camera, and background image to render a mesh over an image
create_colored_renderer: call _create_renderer with width, height, and camera parameters to build a ColoredRenderer with a ProjectPoints camera
apply_lambertian_lighting: call simple_renderer with a renderer, verts, faces, and color to apply multi-point Lambertian lighting and return the rendered result
